reglesExercice.consigne: En cas d'erreur, la bonne réponse est montrée puis l'activité est reproposée plus loin dans la séance.

activites.question: When do we use 'will + verb'?
reponsesAcceptees: For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'
activites.explication: For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'

activites.question: When do we use 'going to + verb'?
reponsesAcceptees: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'
activites.explication: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'

activites.question: What is the Zero Conditional? (If + present, present)
reponsesAcceptees: For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'
activites.explication: For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'

activites.question: What is the First Conditional? (If + present, will + verb)
reponsesAcceptees: For real/possible future situations. Ex: 'If I pass the bac, I will go to university.'
activites.explication: For real/possible future situations. Ex: 'If I pass the bac, I will go to university.'

activites.question: When do we use 'will + verb'?
options: Subject + verb-ed. Ex: 'He worked hard yesterday.'
For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'
activites.explication: For predictions, spontaneous decisions, promises. Ex: 'I will help you.'

activites.question: When do we use 'going to + verb'?
options: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'
For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'
In my opinion, I believe that, From my point of view, It seems to me that.
activites.explication: For planned intentions and predictions based on evidence. Ex: 'I'm going to study medicine.'

activites.question: What is the Zero Conditional? (If + present, present) ?
options: For actions in progress at a specific past time, or background actions. Ex: 'I was reading when he called.'
For unreal past situations (regrets). Ex: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.'
'I lived' = completed (I don't live there anymore). 'I have lived' = still true now or recent.
For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'
activites.explication: For general truths. Ex: 'If you heat water, it boils.'

reglesApprentissage.consigne: L'anglais s'apprend par la production, pas par la mémorisation espacée. L'élève découvre le mot en contexte, le tape, le dit à voix haute, puis le réutilise. Toute réponse incorrecte est reproposée immédiatement dans la même séance, jusqu'à réussite. Aucune carte n'entre dans la file de révision espacée.
